ev.q: In teenagers the release starts later, sometimes not until eleven o'clock or after.

1.why: B段主旨：青少年体内褪黑素（控制睡眠时间的激素）释放得更晚。i A hormone that arrives late ↔ melatonin, a hormone … In teenagers the release starts later。ii 是干扰：段中没有讨论屏幕，屏幕在F段才出现。

ev.q: they will get well under the eight to ten hours of sleep that experts recommend for this age group

2.why: C段：学校开课早，青少年睡眠严重不足，并带来注意力差等后果。iv Too little sleep before an early start ↔ most schools begin early … well under the eight to ten hours of sleep that experts recommend。

ev.q: Researchers gave students wrist monitors to record their sleep before and after the change

3.why: D段：西雅图推迟上课时间，研究者用手环测量前后的睡眠变化。v Measuring the effect of a later timetable ↔ moved the start of the school day … record their sleep before and after the change。

ev.q: Changing the timetable can be costly

4.why: E段：反对者担心成本（校车）、家长上班、放学后时间不够等实际问题。vi Worries about the cost and practical effects of change ↔ can be costly … worry about who will look after their children … less time for sport。x 是干扰：段中没有说老师拒绝改变。

ev.q: Researchers stress, however, that school timetables are only part of the answer.

5.why: F段：美国儿科学会建议、加州立法（官方支持），但研究者强调上课时间只是部分答案，还要限制夜间用屏。vii Official support, but not a complete answer ↔ recommended … legal requirement … only part of the answer。只看后半句容易选 ii，但F段并没有说青少年更喜欢屏幕而不睡觉。

ev.q: which suggests that it is a natural part of growing up rather than a bad habit

6.why: B段末句。A a normal stage of development ↔ a natural part of growing up。D 正是 Moore 否定的（rather than a bad habit）；C 与 found in many different countries and cultures 相反；B 是A段过去的看法。

ev.q: they will get well under the eight to ten hours of sleep that experts recommend for this age group

7.why: C段。B often get less sleep than is recommended ↔ get well under the eight to ten hours of sleep that experts recommend。A 与原文相反（cannot fall asleep before eleven）；C、D 与原文的后果描述相反。

ev.q: mainly because they woke up later, not because they went to bed any earlier

8.why: D段。D got up later in the morning ↔ mainly because they woke up later。A 是原文明确否定的（not because they went to bed any earlier），也是最容易被误选的；C 屏幕在F段，与西雅图研究无关。

ev.q: argues that these problems are real but can usually be solved with careful planning

9.why: E段末句。C can generally be dealt with ↔ can usually be solved with careful planning。A 与原文相反；B 不对：他承认这些问题是真实存在的（these problems are real），并不是误解。

ev.q: Lack of sleep has been linked to poor concentration, low mood and a greater risk of accidents

10.why: C段。A shortage of sleep ↔ Lack of sleep；has been connected with ↔ has been linked to；weak concentration ↔ poor concentration。accidents 已在题干中出现，空格对应中间一项 low mood。

ev.q: Researchers gave students wrist monitors to record their sleep

11.why: D段。measured sleep with ↔ to record their sleep；that the students wore ↔ gave students wrist monitors。

ev.q: particularly where the same buses are used to carry younger children to primary schools at different times of the morning

12.why: E段。expensive ↔ costly；shared by different schools ↔ the same buses are used to carry younger children to primary schools at different times。

ev.q: the light from screens can delay the release of melatonin even further

13.why: F段末句。push back ↔ delay；Screen light ↔ the light from screens。B段说明 melatonin 是控制睡眠时间的激素。
